formulations.Notes: Salt:AN = 1.2 (Li:CN 1.2); ratio fields are per total monomer. Conductivity maximum at 75 wt%. Conductivities digitised from Fig. 2 (log sigma -6.7/20 C, -5.9/30 C, -4.7/60 C, -4.4/70 C); they agree with Fig. 5 and the text (~1e-7 at 20 C, ~1e-5 at 60 C). Amorphous, flexible, transparent. Other loadings in Fig. 5 (~22, ~55, ~84, ~92 wt%) are not recorded because their concentrations are only readable from the plot; >90 wt% is a viscous metastable liquid.
